name: incremental-splice
body: The win-C database build: on the incremental path it seeds a working copy of the previous `db.lbug`, applies the phase-2 code delta as DML, and publishes `db.lbug` + `graph.jsonl` atomically. It writes only the code tables — Language / Module / Struct / Function / File / UnresolvedTarget and their rels — and assumes the seed already holds the current authored/transient rows by write-through. The seeded+spliced DB is a full rebuild exactly when that assumption holds.
